text: “I see,” she said. “It was very easy.” “Of course you understand, Mrs. Revel, that that is not the only letter. There are others.” “Dear me,” said Virginia, “I seem to have been frightfully indiscreet.” Again she could see that her light tone puzzled him. She was by now thoroughly enjoying herself. “At any rate,” she said, smiling sweetly at him, “it’s very kind of you to call and give them back to me.” There was a pause as he cleared his throat.
